name: CDSAB
description: This software release contains the core source code and experimental pipeline accompanying the study on alignment-guided Chinese text similarity. It supports reproducible comparison of lexical, semantic, global, chunk-based, and local alignment-guided similarity methods across multiple Chinese text similarity settings. The implementation includes data preprocessing, controlled pair construction, lexical baselines such as TF-IDF, character n-grams and BM25-style similarity, semantic embedding baselines, chunk-based long-text representation, local segment alignment, alignment-aware aggregation, evaluation, and result generation. The pipeline is designed to investigate how text length, representation choice, local alignment, and aggregation strategy influence Chinese text similarity measurement across literary, chapter-level, and legal-domain evaluation tasks. This software is released together with the CDSAB benchmark dataset, which is archived separately on Zenodo so that the data and code can be independently versioned and cited. The software package contains the core implementation required to reproduce the experiments reported in the associated study. Large generated outputs, pretrained model files, and third-party datasets are not redistributed unless their licenses permit redistribution.
